cards.name: Tangrowth
cards.description: Its arms are made of plants that bind themselves to things. They grow back right away if cut.

cards.name: Toxicroak
cards.description: It has a poison sac at its throat. When it croaks, the stored poison is churned for more potency.

cards.name: Aerodactyl
cards.description: A Pokémon that roamed the skies in the dinosaur era. Its teeth are like saw blades.

cards.name: Bronzong
cards.description: It brought rains by opening portals to another world. It was revered as a bringer of plentiful harvests.

cards.name: Cherrim
cards.description: If it senses strong sunlight, it opens its folded petals to absorb the sun's rays with its whole body.

cards.name: Gengar
cards.description: The leer that floats in darkness belongs to a Gengar delighting in casting curses on people.

cards.name: Glalie
cards.description: It prevents prey from escaping by instantaneously freezing moisture in the air.

cards.name: Froslass
cards.description: It freezes prey by blowing its -58 degrees F breath. It is said to then secretly display its prey.

cards.name: Hariyama
cards.description: It loves to match power with big-bodied Pokémon. It can knock a truck flying with its arm thrusts.

cards.name: Lopunny
cards.description: The ears appear to be delicate. If they are touched roughly, it kicks with its graceful legs.

cards.name: Manectric
cards.description: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.

cards.name: Omastar
cards.description: It is thought that this Pokémon became extinct because its spiral shell grew too large.

cards.name: Pelipper
cards.description: It is a messenger of the skies, carrying small Pokémon and eggs to safety in its bill.

cards.name: Pichu
cards.description: The electric sacs in its cheeks are small. If even a little electricity leaks, it becomes shocked.

cards.name: Raichu
cards.description: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.

cards.name: Raticate
cards.description: It whittles its constantly growing fangs by gnawing on hard things. It can chew apart cinder walls.

cards.name: Heatran
cards.description: Its body is made of rugged steel. However, it is partially melted in spots because of its own heat.

cards.name: Sceptile
cards.description: The leaves that grow on its arms can slice down thick trees. It is without peer in jungle combat.

cards.name: Bronzong

cards.name: Bronzor
cards.description: There are researchers who believe this Pokémon reflected like a mirror in the distant past.

cards.name: Charmeleon
cards.description: In the rocky mountains where Charmeleon live, their fiery tails shine at night like stars.

cards.name: Gastly
cards.description: Born from gases, anyone would faint if engulfed by its gaseous body, which contains poison.

cards.name: Graveler
cards.description: It rolls on mountain paths to move. Once it builds momentum, no Pokémon can stop it without difficulty.

cards.name: Grovyle
cards.description: It lives in dense jungles. While closing in on its prey, it leaps from branch to branch.

cards.description: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.

cards.description: While it loves floral honey, it won't gather any itself. Instead, it plots to steal some from Combee.

cards.name: Cherubi
cards.description: The small ball is not only filled with nutrients, it is also tasty. Starly try to peck it off.

cards.name: Croagunk
cards.description: It rarely fights fairly, but that is strictly to ensure survival. It is popular as a mascot.

cards.description: Using electricity stored in its fur, it stimulates its muscles to heighten its reaction speed.

cards.name: Nosepass
cards.description: When endangered, it may protect itself by raising its magnetism and drawing iron objects to its body.

cards.name: Omanyte

cards.name: Rattata

cards.name: Snorunt
cards.description: It is said that several Snorunt gather under giant leaves and live together in harmony.
